name: Independent cryptic crossword, Penguin book 1 No 43

clue.text: One gets more irritable about bit of noise — from me?
One opening to graveyard around church keeping de- ceased outside
Cheat in somehow concealing tax due to state
A fish in the seaweed
Take little time to get wild celery
Salad recipe with a particular type of food
Jacob’s son in short trousers
Dispose of woman’s body maybe in the break
Buck, northern worker unhealthy and inactive
Indian people having a set of beliefs that’s not died
Holy one inhabits saint? That’s about right
Fragments of stuff, hostile, to knock chap back
Pop group not allowed to be listened to
Being naughty made Pa slap part of anatomy
A tiny child holds my French fossil
No liturgy should offer rock
Prophet creates a stink after the ultimate in sin
Sweetheart upset over noise being very disagreeable
Rodent, brown, climbing palm
Slack dope? I hint ’e should be changed — thus?
Study boringly unoriginal? One’s very sorry
Organ magnificent, the Chinese say?
To move to see somewhere else
Spectral emanation in place most weird
Stewed carp pie — with hesitation one may eat it
Singers and actors only half sane
Can no gentleman with power rise to the top?
Went on horse with loop — in this display?
Applause amidst the clatter
